results.title: Trump says US has ‘total control’ of Strait of Hormuz, Iran hits back
results.description: US President Donald Trump has escalated tensions with Iran by describing the Strait of Hormuz as “new U.S. Territory” and claiming Washington has total control. Tehran rejected the claim and said the waterway will remain closed until its demands are met.
